column1: # Hand-written translation facts, merged over the generated rows of shader_facts.tsv by dm/gfx/tools/shader_split.py: key <TAB> facts JSON (same format)
# This game has no PC version, so the translator has no fragment output types and declares every output float; Metal refuses a pipeline whose float output meets an integer attachment
# (the host's red line then prints the row to add here).
# EVERY pixel shader that writes colour target 5 is listed here, not only the ones a run reached: the game attaches that target as R8Uint (its shadow /
# lighting-channel mask) and no shader in the map writes colour 6 or 7, so target 5 is the last attachment and has one format. The first 323 rows were
# printed by the host on an iPhone; the rest are the same declaration applied to the remaining writers (5,800 in total). A shader this table is wrong
# about would be refused in the other direction (an integer output against a float attachment) and shows up in the log as such.
